description:
Make examples answer “Can Jido do my job?” and “Can I run the proof?”

Exit criteria:
- Every home use case links to a relevant example.
- Every public example has a task, outcome, packages, maturity, prerequisites, expected result, source, and validation date.
- Production claims have direct failure, state, trace, and deployment proof.
- Operational-control claims link to one integrated example and to small examples for denial, quotas, causal history, telemetry, and redaction.

Backlog tasks: 46

Source: Jido Site Improvement Backlog 2026-07-23.md

comments.text: Session-achievable core done: example detail pages in sitemap (T31), status model confirmed sound (T30), task-oriented taxonomy labels added (T01). Residual (large, tracked): full example card contract across 22 examples, examples-hub search/filters UI, and new runnable proof examples (crash-restart, state-restore, signal trace) which require real agent source + LiveView modules to build safely.

Product decision 2026-07-24: keep the Examples hub simple and card-based in this iteration. Do not add text search, filters, operational-control filters, or URL-persisted filter state. Improve discovery through clear cards, use-case entry points, and direct documentation links. Filter work can be reconsidered in a future iteration.

title: E08 — Turn examples into direct proof
